answer: The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the ledge queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 625 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the atlas. Honest users pay that once, farms 14 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
